name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
restricted_to: Students above the 80th percentile in their Class 12 board exam (merit-based selection)
source: National Scholarship Portal, scholarships.gov.in (for students above the 80th percentile in their Class 12 board)

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships
restricted_to: Selected through a competitive aptitude test and interview
source: scholarships.reliancefoundation.org (up to ₹2,00,000 over the degree; selection includes an aptitude test)

name: Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships
restricted_to: First-year postgraduates in specified STEM fields (e.g. computer science, AI, mathematics and computing, engineering, life sciences), selected on merit
source: scholarships.reliancefoundation.org (up to ₹6,00,000 over the degree)

name: HDFC Bank Parivartan's Educational Crisis Scholarship Support (ECSS)
source: HDFC Bank Parivartan programme, administered via buddy4study.com (amount varies by course level)

name: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship Scheme
source: licindia.in (higher amounts for engineering and medicine)

name: SBI Asha Scholarship Programme
source: sbifoundation.in (amount and income limit vary by level; school level shown)

name: Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship Programme
source: Tata Capital CSR programme, administered via buddy4study.com

name: Vidyadhan Scholarship
restricted_to: Students in states where a Vidyadhan programme is running (check the current state list)
source: vidyadhan.org

name: Foundation for Excellence Scholarship
restricted_to: High-merit students (e.g. top JEE or NEET ranks), selected by the foundation
source: ffe.org (for high-merit students in engineering, medicine and law)

name: Bharti Airtel Scholarship
restricted_to: Students admitted to technology courses at top-50 NIRF engineering institutions
source: bhartiairtelfoundation.org (covers up to the full annual fee)

name: IIT tuition fee remission for low-income families
provider: Indian Institutes of Technology (Ministry of Education norms)
restricted_to: Students admitted to an IIT (full waiver below ₹1 lakh income, two-thirds remission from ₹1–5 lakh)
source: Ministry of Education fee norms for IITs; JoSAA business rules, josaa.nic.in

name: NIT tuition fee remission for low-income families
provider: National Institutes of Technology (Ministry of Education norms)
restricted_to: Students admitted to an NIT (full waiver below ₹1 lakh income, two-thirds remission from ₹1–5 lakh)
source: Ministry of Education fee norms for NITs; JoSAA business rules, josaa.nic.in

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (Class 9 and 10)
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
restricted_to: Scheduled Caste students in Class 9 and 10
source: National Scholarship Portal and state scholarship portals, scholarships.gov.in

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
restricted_to: Scheduled Caste students (covers compulsory fees plus a maintenance allowance)
source: National Scholarship Portal and state scholarship portals, scholarships.gov.in

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students
restricted_to: Scheduled Tribe students (covers compulsory fees plus a maintenance allowance)
source: National Scholarship Portal and state scholarship portals, scholarships.gov.in

name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
restricted_to: OBC, EBC and DNT students
source: National Scholarship Portal and state scholarship portals, scholarships.gov.in

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
restricted_to: Students from the six notified minority communities
source: National Scholarship Portal, scholarships.gov.in

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses (Minorities)
restricted_to: Students from the six notified minority communities in professional or technical courses
source: National Scholarship Portal, scholarships.gov.in (course fee up to ₹20,000 plus maintenance)

name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
restricted_to: Scheduled Caste students admitted to notified top institutions
source: National Scholarship Portal, scholarships.gov.in (full tuition up to ₹2,00,000 a year plus allowances)

name: National Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students (Top Class)
restricted_to: Scheduled Tribe students admitted to notified top institutions
source: Ministry of Tribal Affairs scholarship portal, tribal.nic.in

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education
restricted_to: Girl students (up to two per family) in AICTE-approved technical institutions
source: aicte-india.org and National Scholarship Portal, scholarships.gov.in

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-abled Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education
restricted_to: Students with a disability of 40% or more in AICTE-approved technical institutions
source: aicte-india.org and National Scholarship Portal, scholarships.gov.in

name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship
provider: All India Council for Technical Education
restricted_to: Orphans, children of parents who died of COVID-19, and wards of armed forces or central police personnel martyred in action
source: aicte-india.org and National Scholarship Portal, scholarships.gov.in

name: AICTE PG Scholarship for GATE/GPAT-qualified Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education
restricted_to: GATE or GPAT-qualified students in AICTE-approved M.Tech, M.E. or M.Pharm programmes
source: aicte-india.org (₹12,400 a month)

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
restricted_to: Top performers in Class 12 (or top JEE/NEET ranks) studying natural and basic sciences
source: online-inspire.gov.in

name: Post-Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
restricted_to: A single girl child of her parents in a regular non-professional postgraduate course
source: ugc.gov.in and National Scholarship Portal, scholarships.gov.in

name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship
restricted_to: Girl students admitted to professional degree courses at NIRF or NAAC-accredited institutions
source: kotakeducation.org

name: Santoor Women's Scholarship
provider: Wipro Cares and Wipro Consumer Care
restricted_to: Girls who studied Class 10 and 12 in government schools in participating states (including Karnataka and Telangana)
source: santoorscholarships.com

name: Vidyasiri Scholarship (Karnataka)
provider: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
restricted_to: Backward class students in Karnataka
source: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal, ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana
restricted_to: Open-category students domiciled in Maharashtra in professional courses (fee reimbursement)
source: MahaDBT portal, mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
restricted_to: Girls who studied Class 6 to 12 in government schools in Tamil Nadu
source: pudhumaipenn.tn.gov.in (₹1,000 a month)

name: Tamil Puthalvan Scheme
restricted_to: Boys who studied Class 6 to 12 in government schools in Tamil Nadu
source: Government of Tamil Nadu, Social Welfare Department (₹1,000 a month)
